blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Просунь палец сквозь ___ (горло, acc. sg.)!
exercises.prompt: Stick your finger through your throat!
exercises.why: **горло → горло** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. горло · горла · горлу · горло · горлом · горле; pl. горла · горл · горлам · горла · горлами · горлах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Через ___ (какое время, acc. sg.) загорается светофор?
exercises.prompt: How long do the traffic lights take to change?
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. Declines like DLI's имя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **какой → какое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. русское. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. время · времени · времени · время · временем · времени; pl. времена · времён · временам · времена · временами · временах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я напрочь забыл про ___ (собрание, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I completely forgot about the meeting.
exercises.why: **собрание → собрание** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. собрание · собрания · собранию · собрание · собранием · собрании; pl. собрания · собраний · собраниям · собрания · собраниями · собраниях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Гелий способен проникать сквозь ___ (стекло, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Helium is capable of penetrating glass.
exercises.why: **стекло → стекло** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. стекло · стекла · стеклу · стекло · стеклом · стекле; pl. стёкла · стёкол · стёклам · стёкла · стёклами · стёклах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том перегнулся через ___ (перила, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Tom leaned over the banister.
exercises.why: **перила → перила** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural перила. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): перила · перил · перилам · перила · перилами · перилах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мне следует тебя поколотить за все те гадости, что ты сказал про ___ (моя тётя, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I ought to pummel you for everything obnoxious you said about my aunt.
exercises.why: **тётя → тётю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's тётя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. тётю). Ending -я → -ю.  **мой → мою** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with тётю). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. тётя · тёти · тёте · тётю · тётей · тёте; pl. тёти · тёть · тётям · тёть · тётями · тётях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ради неё я пройду сквозь ___ (огонь, acc. sg.) в пропитанных бензином подштанниках.
exercises.prompt: I'd walk through fire with gasoline-soaked underpants for her.
exercises.why: **огонь → огонь** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. огонь · огня · огню · огонь · огнём · огне; pl. огни · огней · огням · огни · огнями · огнях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Падающая звезда пронеслась через ___ (небосвод, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: A shooting star dashed through the sky.
exercises.why: **небосвод → небосвод** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. небосвод · небосвода · небосводу · небосвод · небосводом · небосводе; pl. небосводы · небосводов · небосводам · небосводы · небосводами · небосводах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Кто-нибудь заметил, что в грамматиках эсперанто никогда не говорится про ___ (пунктуация, acc. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: Has anyone noticed that in Esperanto grammars they never talk about punctuation?
exercises.why: **пунктуация → пунктуацию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия. Declines like DLI's армия — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. пунктуация · пунктуации · пунктуации · пунктуацию · пунктуацией · пунктуации; pl. пунктуации · пунктуаций · пунктуациям · пунктуации · пунктуациями · пунктуациях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Когда я смотрел сквозь ___ (туман, acc. sg.), моё будущее промелькнуло у меня перед глазами.
exercises.prompt: In looking through the mist, I caught a glimpse of my future.
exercises.why: **туман → туман** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. туман · тумана · туману · туман · туманом · тумане; pl. туманы · туманов · туманам · туманы · туманами · туманах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Через ___ (год, acc. sg.) родился Поль.
exercises.prompt: One year later, Paul was born.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Про ___ (графиня, acc. sg.) Лидию Ивановну, пожалуйста, не говорите дурного.
exercises.prompt: *Лев Толстой, «Анна Каренина»*
exercises.why: **графиня → графиню** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's тётя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. тётю). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. графиня · графини · графине · графиню · графиней · графине; pl. графини · графинь · графиням · графинь · графинями · графинях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Саша (шутя, сквозь ___ (слеза, acc. pl.)).
exercises.prompt: *Антон Чехов, «Иванов»*
exercises.why: **слеза → слезы** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural слёзы. Ending -а → -ы.  Declension: sg. слеза · слезы · слезе · слезу · слезой · слезе; pl. слёзы · слёз · слезам · слёзы · слезами · слезах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Возвращайся через ___ (час, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Come back in an hour.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Чтоб все помнили именно про ___ (та коронация, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: *Юрий Тынянов, «Восковая персона»*
exercises.why: **коронация → коронацию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия. Declines like DLI's армия — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  **тот → ту** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with коронацию). «тот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): та · той · той · ту · той · той.  Declension: sg. коронация · коронации · коронации · коронацию · коронацией · коронации; pl. коронации · коронаций · коронациям · коронации · коронациями · коронациях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Вахнов продолжал выть, внимательно наблюдая сквозь ___ (палец, acc. pl.) учителя.
exercises.prompt: *Николай Гарин-Михайловский, «Детство Тёмы»*
exercises.why: **палец → пальцы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural пальцы. The form changes by more than its ending, so no single ending is given — see the declension below.  Declension: sg. палец · пальца · пальцу · палец · пальцем · пальце; pl. пальцы · пальцев · пальцам · пальцы · пальцами · пальцах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мост перекинут через ___ (бухта, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The bridge crosses the bay.
exercises.why: **бухта → бухту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. бухта · бухты · бухте · бухту · бухтой · бухте; pl. бухты · бухт · бухтам · бухты · бухтами · бухтах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В глубине сквозь ___ (стекло, acc. pl.) длинная очередь голубоватых юниф.
exercises.prompt: *Евгений Замятин, «Мы»*
exercises.why: **стекло → стекла** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural стёкла. Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. стекло · стекла · стеклу · стекло · стеклом · стекле; pl. стёкла · стёкол · стёклам · стёкла · стёклами · стёклах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. exercises.q: Я перескочила через ___ (ручей, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I pranced over the creek.
exercises.why: **ручей → ручей** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -й. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ручей · ручья · ручью · ручей · ручьём · ручье; pl. ручьи · ручьёв · ручьям · ручьи · ручьями · ручьях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive.
